display.purpose: Primary page task and current decision context.

body.purpose: Readable research, explanation, and decision context.

mono.purpose: Tabular values, prices, identifiers, and technical data.

shadows.name: surface-detail
shadows.purpose: Restrained local lift for compact interactive elements.

motion.name: base
motion.purpose: Opening and closing local interface layers.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One clear action within a decision context.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #FFFFFF; border-radius: 4px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0A0A0A; font: 600 14px Geist, Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E5E5E5; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action that remains clear without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #404040; border-radius: 4px; background: #171717; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 14px Geist, Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #262626; border-color: #808080; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Data Field
components.description: A compact field for research and account input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #A3A3A3; font: 600 11px Geist, Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { height: 40px; border: 1px solid #404040; border-radius: 4px; background: #171717; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 0 12px; font: 400 14px Geist, Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Semantic Status
components.description: A semantic financial state with text, not color alone.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,.45); border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(16,185,129,.14); color: #34D399; font: 600 12px Geist, Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Workspace Metric
components.description: Inline metric content; use as a strip rather than a repeated equal-card grid.
components.css: .ds-metric { display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 180px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 4px; background: #111111; } .ds-metric span { color: #A3A3A3; font: 600 11px Geist, Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-metric strong { color: #10B981; font: 600 22px Geist, Inter, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric small { color: #A3A3A3; font: 400 12px Geist, Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: The selected workspace destination uses inversion for immediate location awareness.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 220px; padding: 8px; background: #111111; font: 500 14px Geist, Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 4px; color: #A3A3A3; } .ds-nav a.is-active { background: #FFFFFF; color: #0A0A0A; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Zenin is a dark-first product workspace that turns fragmented market signals into an inspectable decision trail. It uses a near-black surface hierarchy, compact geometric corners, and purposeful semantic color so portfolio performance, risk, freshness, and warnings communicate quickly without becoming visual decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Dense but legible workspace geometry built on a four-pixel spacing scale.
Semantic color reserved for financial meaning, state, and actionability.
Low-radius controls and containers with crisp borders rather than soft, decorative elevation.
One consistent workflow: observe, investigate, decide, journal, review.

rules.name: Meaning-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Neutral controls, inactive navigation, and ordinary structure stay monochrome. Color must identify performance, risk, warning, freshness, or a direct state—not add atmosphere.

rules.name: Evidence-First Type Rule
rules.body: Use strong type to identify decisions and financial values, not to give every panel a headline.

rules.name: Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards and sections communicate grouping with surface tone, border, and spacing. Shadow signals a layer that has left the page plane.

dos: Do keep the decision path visible: context first, analysis next, and a route into journaling or review where appropriate.
Do use semantic color only for clear financial or operational meaning.
donts: Don't make Zenin resemble a decorative crypto dashboard with glow, ornamental charts, or speculative visual effects.
Don't add colored side stripes thicker than 1px.
Don't turn every metric or section into an equal-weight card.
